NOTICES FOR THE COMPONENTS SHIPPED WITH VANILLA

Vanilla itself is under the BSD 3-Clause licence; that text is 'LICENSE',
beside the executable. What follows is about the components which travel
with it.


Qt
--

Vanilla uses the Qt libraries under the GNU Lesser General Public License
version 3. The version shipped here is Qt 6.11.1, in the binaries built and
published by The Qt Company; they are not modified.

  LGPL-3.0-only.txt   the LGPLv3 itself
  GPL-3.0-only.txt    the GPLv3, which the LGPLv3 builds upon

The corresponding source is published at

  https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.11/6.11.1/single/

Qt is linked dynamically. Its libraries sit next to 'vanilla.exe' as separate
DLLs, so they can be replaced with another build of the same Qt version
without rebuilding vanilla.


Qt WebEngine and Chromium
-------------------------

Qt WebEngine 6.11.1 is one of those Qt libraries, and it carries Chromium
(based on Chromium 140.0.7339.264) together with the third-party code
Chromium itself carries.

  LICENSE.Chromium    Chromium's own licence

The full list of the third-party components inside Qt WebEngine, with their
licences, is published by The Qt Company as "Qt WebEngine Third-Party Code":

  https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtwebengine-3rdparty.html


Microsoft Edge WebView2
-----------------------

'WebView2Loader.dll' comes from the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 SDK. Its licence
and notices are in 'licenses/webview2/'. The Edge WebView2 runtime itself is
not shipped here; it is what the loader looks for on the machine.


Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable
------------------------------------

'vc_redist.x64.exe' is Microsoft's redistributable installer for the Visual
C++ runtime, included under the distribution terms which come with Visual
Studio. It is Microsoft's binary, unmodified.
